before-completing-pandemonium.npc: Indeed! It's kind of what I do. The name's Virginia. I'm a lookout for the spirit anglers, as well as a six time eye spy world champion.

before-completing-pandemonium.player: And what are you on the lookout for at the moment?

before-completing-pandemonium.npc: To be honest, a new adventure. The anglers have been good to me, but after the chaos with Tempoross, I'd like a fresh start.

before-completing-pandemonium.player: Makes sense. Well, I hope one finds you soon.

before-completing-pandemonium.npc: I hope so too, but not before I find it first!

options.text: How about you join my crew?

steps.text: If the player's Sailing level is under 90 or has less than 100 Tempoross subdues:

steps.player: Maybe I could help? How about you join my crew?

steps.npc: Sorry, but I can't see that happening right now. Maybe once you're more experienced.

steps.text: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 90 Sailing. Have subdued the Tempoross 100 times.
If the player's Sailing level is at least 90 and has at least 100 Tempoross subdues:

steps.player: Maybe I could help? How about you join my crew?

steps.npc: Sure! I can watch your back!

steps.text: You recruit Spotter Virginia as a crew member. She departs for the Pandemonium.

steps.player: Well, I hope one finds you soon.

steps.npc: I hope so too, but not before I find it first!

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: Hello there. How are things going?

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: Pretty good. I'm very much enjoying seeing the sights.

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: Well, let me know if you spot anything worth looking into.

steps.npc: These sails are blocking my view.
I can't focus on being the lookout with all this work to do.
